instructions.water_wont_stop: Turn off the main water valve, usually where the water line enters the house or near the water meter.
instructions.gas_smell: Leave the building at once. Do not use switches, lighters or phones inside. Call the gas utility's emergency number or 911 from outside.
instructions.sewage_backup: Stop using sinks, tubs, showers and toilets until a plumber has looked at it.
